summary.zh-CN: 从 GitHub 与 Linear 继续本地 Agent 任务，并改善菜单、聊天状态与运行恢复。
summary.en-US: Continue local agent work from GitHub and Linear, with clearer actions, chat status and runtime recovery.

body.zh-CN: GitHub、Linear 和官方讨论连接到同一个本地 Codex 任务，提前显示状态并支持暂停、恢复、取消。独立 CLI/SDK 支持自定义来源和同账号签名 Agent。
body.en-US: Connect GitHub, Linear and official discussions to persistent local Codex tasks, with early status and pause/resume/cancel controls. A standalone CLI/SDK supports custom sources and signed same-account agents.

body.zh-CN: 页面菜单、设置分组与侧栏反馈保持一致；聊天只为当前活动回复显示加载动画，过程摘要更简洁。
body.en-US: Page menus, settings groups and sidebar feedback are consistent. Only the active reply animates, and process summaries stay concise.

body.zh-CN: 改善移动端恢复连接、渠道控制标签、应用面板定位与 HTTPS 语音提示；修复 systemd 受控重启续接，状态显示实际运行版本，便携版提供手动下载。
body.en-US: Improve mobile reconnection, channel reply tags, panel targeting and HTTPS voice guidance. Restore eligible sessions after controlled systemd restarts, show the running API version, and offer manual portable downloads.

body.zh-CN: 外部协作需要 Node.js 22.13+、在线电脑与运行中的宿主。本批不发布桌面安装器；旧讨论迁移保留绑定。
body.en-US: External collaboration requires Node.js 22.13+, an online computer and a running host. This batch does not publish desktop installers; discussion migration preserves bindings.
